surfaces.name: Ordewell VS Code / Open VSX extension
Ordewell desktop app (Electron; source only, not in releases)

claims.answer: Terminal UI and CLI on macOS, Linux and Windows (Windows via npm), a VS Code and Open VSX extension, and a loopback-only API daemon; the Electron desktop app exists in source but is not in releases; no browser or mobile client.

desktop_os.answer: Electron desktop app is packaged for macOS, Windows and Linux in electron-builder, but docs say it is not in a release yet; the terminal UI runs on macOS, Linux and Windows.

mobile_apps.answer: No iOS or Android client in the repository packages (cli, core, desktop, ui, vscode, web).

browser.answer: The web package states it has no frontend and a browser UI may come later.

mobile_browser.answer: No browser UI exists, so no phone browser access.

cli.answer: ordewell CLI with a full-screen TUI and headless commands.

editor_extensions.answer: VS Code Marketplace and Open VSX extension (Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium).

task_actions.answer: Start (plan, run), steer (messages to a running task, continue), approve plans and checkpoints, review diffs, merge, retry, resume sessions.

notifications.answer: ORDEWELL_NOTIFY_COMMAND runs a user command when something waits on the user; no native push or mobile notifications documented.

cross_device_continuity.answer: The daemon binds to loopback and the session lease allows one live host per session; no cross-device access is documented.

limitations: Desktop app is source-only; there is no browser UI (the daemon serves JSON only) and no phone client.

claims.answer: Eight coding-agent runners (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, Qwen Code, Cline, Gemini CLI, Cursor) mixable per task, plus planners on API providers; Ordewell launches and drives each CLI through structured transports and an injected MCP server.

harnesses.answer: Eight supported coding agents are listed in the README.

model_providers.answer: API planners via OpenRouter, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Moonshot/Kimi and xAI; runners use their own providers.

custom_adapters.answer: ADR-0060 treats ACP runners as data on one connector and the runner registry is extensible in source; no documented user plugin API.

session_integration.answer: Structured runner transport and an Ordewell MCP server for completion and checkpoints.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: README: agents can be mixed freely within one plan; screenshot plan mixes claude-code, opencode and codex.

limitations: Not fully established: custom_adapters.

claims.answer: Runners and harness planners use the coding agent's own subscription login; API keys are supported for API planners and for Qwen Code, Cline and Gemini CLI; no vendor credits.

agent_subscriptions.answer: Harness planners need no API key because the agent is signed in on its own; the footer shows Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode Go plan limits.

api_accounts.answer: Provider keys for API planners and for Qwen Code, Cline and Gemini CLI are handed to those runners.

vendor_credits.answer: Free open-source tool with no credit system found.

local_models.answer: Runners such as OpenCode, Qwen Code and Cline can use any provider they support; Ordewell documents no local-model setup.

account_switching.answer: Per-task runner and model switching; moving unfinished work to another agent when a limit is hit; no multi-account manager.

vendor_account_requirement.answer: No Ordewell account; each coding agent must be installed and signed in.

provider_restrictions.answer: The repository documents no provider terms about subscription use through Ordewell.

limitations: Not fully established: vendor_credits, local_models, account_switching, provider_restrictions.
claims.unknownReason: Provider terms are third-party business facts outside the repository.

claims.answer: curl, Homebrew or npm install, then run ordewell in a project and type a goal; a Git repository is recommended (git 2.38+) but not required; no managed cloud or VPS installer.

first_task_setup.answer: Run ordewell, pick planner and runners with /planner and /runners, type a goal.

no_git.answer: Without a git repository tasks run directly in the folder and share the workspace.

local_git_without_remote.answer: Worktree isolation works on local repositories and does no remote operation.

hosted_git.answer: Host git actions can fetch, pull and push to the tracking remote; there is no GitHub integration or pull-request creation.

prerequisite_guidance.answer: README lists supported coding agent installed and signed in, git 2.38+, Git for Windows on Windows.

managed_cloud_setup.answer: No hosted service exists; site and README describe a local install.

byo_vps_onboarding.answer: No remote or VPS installer; the daemon binds loopback only.

limitations: Not fully established: hosted_git, managed_cloud_setup, byo_vps_onboarding.

claims.answer: Full ordewell CLI plus a loopback HTTP and WebSocket daemon with routes for sessions, plans, runners, models, settings, approvals and escalations, all behind a bearer token; no SDK or webhooks; MCP exists for runners and planners only.

cli.answer: Headless commands for plan, run, approve, stop, retry, cancel, merge, decisions and settings.

sdk.answer: No SDK package among the seven packages; @ordewell/core is an internal library.

mcp_server.answer: The Ordewell MCP server is injected per caller for runners and planners; it is not offered to arbitrary external agents.

webhooks.answer: No webhook endpoints or triggers found; ORDEWELL_NOTIFY_COMMAND is a local notification hook.

operations.answer: Create plans, inspect status, steer, stop, cancel, and review via CLI and API.

authentication.answer: Bearer token minted at startup in ~/.ordewell/server-<port>.token, loopback Host only, no Origin header.

stability.answer: Pre-1.0: minor releases can include breaking changes; renamed command handoff to merge.

limitations: Not fully established: sdk, mcp_server, webhooks, stability.

claims.answer: Repository skills attach to tasks; MCP servers a repository declares are allowlisted per hash; each runner keeps its own MCP and plugin setup; Ordewell's own MCP server serves runners.

mcp_client.answer: Planner allowlist can start one exact MCP server a repository declares (mcp-server:<name>@<hash>); runners use their own MCP configuration.

plugins.answer: No plugin system in Ordewell itself; planners never run repository plugins or hooks.

custom_tools.answer: Script tasks run exact commands under approval; no user-defined tool API.

instructions_import.answer: Shared skills in the repository are attached to tasks across runners.

authentication.answer: Provider keys are held by Ordewell for some runners; MCP auth is handled by each tool.

permission_scope.answer: Approval allowlist and denylist for planner commands, web reads and MCP servers.

integration_owner.answer: Ordewell owns its MCP server; other MCP servers come from the repository or runner.

limitations: Not fully established: mcp_client, plugins, custom_tools, authentication.

chat_git_triggers.answer: No chat or Git event triggers.

authoritative_tracker.answer: The saved plan in .ordewell/sessions is the source of truth for tasks.

claims.answer: The plan is the durable object: editable tasks, dependencies, skills and decision record, amendable while running; no per-requirement acceptance field or revision history beyond sessions and forks.

plans.answer: Planner writes ordered tasks with prompts, runners, models and dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.answer: Tasks carry check-and-fix loops and completion reports; no separate acceptance-criteria field documented.

editors.answer: Edit prompts, dependencies and each task's runner, model, effort and mode.

revisions.answer: Decision record with superseded entries, fork, rewind and compaction checkpoints; no plan diff history.

implementation_links.answer: Tasks land on an integration branch with diffs and test evidence; no commit link record beyond the branch.

amendment.answer: Plans can be edited during a run without losing completed work; supervisor Act can edit the plan.

restart_persistence.answer: Sessions are saved in .ordewell/sessions and reload with sessions load.

limitations: Not fully established: acceptance_criteria, revisions, implementation_links.

claims.answer: Tasks form a dependency graph that gates scheduling; failed tasks block only dependents; delegated child plans are held out of releases.

epics.answer: A plan is one goal; delegated child plans implement nesting but are off by default.

hierarchy.answer: Child plans (ADR-0055) are partially implemented and held out by ORDEWELL_DELEGATION.

blockers.answer: task-deps sets which earlier tasks a task waits for; dependents wait for inputs.

readiness.answer: Dependency graph decides what runs in parallel.

enforcement.answer: A blocked task is never started by the scheduler.

state_propagation.answer: A failed task blocks its transitive dependents.

task_to_epic.answer: No conversion of a task into a plan; delegation is a separate task kind.

identity_retention.answer: Not stated for converting a task into a delegated plan.

workflow_constraints.answer: No fixed workflow; the planner shapes the plan per goal.

limitations: Not fully established: epics, hierarchy, task_to_epic, identity_retention.

project_docs.answer: The planner reads the workspace; no managed doc store.

memory.answer: Decision record and compaction checkpoints persist within a session.

scope.answer: Skills have applies-to scope (planner or task).

provenance.answer: Decisions record what stands and what was superseded.

correction.answer: Decisions can be superseded in the conversation.

deletion.answer: Sessions can be deleted with sessions delete.

freshness.answer: Planner is taught to check a brief's facts against the code before freezing them.

takeover_continuity.answer: Sessions are named, forkable and loadable by another process under the session lease.

evidence.title: README.md
evidence.locator: Intro; Features; Installation; How it works; What Ordewell sends; License
evidence.finding: Planner turns a goal into an editable plan run across eight coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, Qwen Code, Cline, Gemini CLI, Cursor); terminal UI, VS Code extension, CLI, local API; install via curl script (macOS/Linux), Homebrew, npm (Windows); worktree isolation; daily version check with opt-out; Apache-2.0.

evidence.title: LICENSE
evidence.finding: Apache License, Version 2.0 for the whole repository; name and logos excluded (NOTICE).

evidence.title: NOTICE
evidence.finding: Copyright Alessandro Costanzo Ciano and contributors; Ordewell name and logos are not licensed.

evidence.title: SECURITY.md
evidence.locator: Supported versions; What is in scope; What each part can touch
evidence.finding: Pre-1.0, only latest supported; planner exploration envelope with OS sandbox on Linux (bubblewrap) and macOS (Seatbelt); runners run as the user without OS sandbox; private advisory reporting with 3-day acknowledgement target.

evidence.title: CHANGELOG.md
evidence.finding: Release notes for 0.13.3: desktop macOS install confirmation, ordewell merge, ordewell decisions, decision record in desktop.

evidence.title: packages/cli/src/help.ts
evidence.locator: printHelp command list and ORDEWELL_* environment
evidence.finding: CLI commands for plan, run, approve, stop, status, sessions, fork, compact, rewind, merge, per-task runner/model/effort/mode/deps/skills, checkpoint, retry, cancel; env vars for approval allowlist, notify command, daemon port, max parallel (default 5).

evidence.title: packages/cli/src/runnerNames.ts
evidence.finding: Runner and planner id lists are read from RunnerRegistry rather than hard-coded.

evidence.title: packages/web/README.md
evidence.finding: Local Hono HTTP+WebSocket daemon on 127.0.0.1:3742 with routes /api/sessions, plans, runners, models, settings, workspaces, approvals, escalations; bearer token minted at startup; no frontend; browser UI may come later.

evidence.title: packages/vscode/README.md
evidence.finding: VS Code extension with editable plan, per-task model/effort, worktree isolation, skills, script tasks, check-and-fix loops, research tasks, plan-limit and cost footers, harness planners.

evidence.title: docs/planners-and-runners.md
evidence.finding: Harness planners use the coding agent's own login; API planners use OpenRouter, Gemini, DeepSeek, Moonshot/Kimi, xAI keys; runners are coding-agent CLIs; Qwen Code and Cline use keys held by Ordewell.

evidence.title: docs/containers.md
evidence.finding: Container mode is experimental and off in published versions; the containers setting is ignored in a release.

evidence.title: docs/desktop/README.md
evidence.finding: Desktop app is not in a release yet: releases do not carry installers; run from source.

evidence.title: docs/skills.md
evidence.finding: Repository skills the planner attaches to tasks across runners.

evidence.title: docs/adr/isolation/0013-worktree-isolation.md
evidence.finding: One checkout per task and one branch per run when the workspace is a git repo group; user opts into merge; no remote operation.

evidence.title: docs/adr/runners/0022-ordewell-mcp-server.md
evidence.finding: One MCP server with per-caller tokens: runners complete tasks and ask checkpoints through it; coding-agent planners read the catalog and submit plans through it.

evidence.title: docs/adr/supervision/0029-the-supervisor.md
evidence.finding: Supervisor level Off, Watch or Act; Act can run, stop, retry, skip, message runners, deny approvals, edit the plan and merge within loop guards.

evidence.title: docs/adr/supervision/0030-global-run-settings.md
evidence.finding: Autorun, supervisor level, merge at gates, parallel limit are global run settings.

evidence.title: docs/adr/supervision/0034-a-failed-task-blocks-only-its-dependents.md
evidence.finding: A failed task blocks only its transitive dependents; independent work keeps starting.

evidence.title: docs/adr/supervision/0035-effects-are-consented-and-recorded.md
evidence.finding: Effects such as pushes need consent and are recorded.

evidence.title: docs/adr/supervision/0037-research-tasks-wake-the-planner.md
evidence.finding: Research tasks report back to the planner that started them.

evidence.title: docs/adr/supervision/0045-a-check-repeats-with-its-fix-until-it-passes.md
evidence.finding: Check-and-fix loops repeat until the check passes or the round limit.

evidence.title: docs/adr/isolation/0049-a-session-has-one-live-host.md
evidence.finding: Session lease: one live host per session; two hosts once ran one session.

evidence.title: docs/adr/supervision/0053-what-waits-on-a-person-is-derived-and-answered-in-one-call.md
evidence.finding: What waits on a person (approvals, checkpoints, conflicts, failures) is derived once and answered through one call; listed at /escalations.

evidence.title: docs/adr/supervision/0055-a-delegated-task-is-a-child-plan-behind-the-runner-seam.md
evidence.finding: Delegated child plans partially implemented; delegation held out by ORDEWELL_DELEGATION=1.

evidence.title: docs/adr/isolation/0062-user-git-actions-are-confirmed-at-a-host-and-a-live-run-holds-only-its-landing-branch.md
evidence.finding: Host git actions: commit, branch, stash, fetch, pull, push to tracking remote for the user; arbitrary merge, rebase and pull requests are later.

evidence.title: docs/adr/surfaces/0063-the-desktop-app-is-an-electron-client-of-the-shared-daemon.md
evidence.finding: Desktop app is an Electron client of the shared local daemon.

evidence.title: packages/core/src/services/VersionCheck.ts
evidence.finding: Daily version check can be turned off by ORDEWELL_NO_VERSION_CHECK=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

evidence.title: .github/workflows/release.yml
evidence.finding: Release builds CLI archives for darwin and linux (arm64, x64), install.sh and SHA256SUMS; desktop is built only when ORDEWELL_RELEASE_DESKTOP is true.

evidence.title: packages/core/src/services/AccountLimitMonitor.ts
evidence.finding: Reads Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode Go plan-limit windows for display and pauses.

evidence.title: packages/core/src/services/SlotPool.ts
evidence.finding: Parallel limit across a plan tree.

evidence.title: packages/core/src/services
evidence.locator: bounded search at v0.13.3 of packages/ and docs/: saml, oidc, scim, rbac, single sign, cron, webhook, scheduled run, gh pr create, spend limit, max-budget, rollback
evidence.finding: Bounded search found no SSO/SAML/OIDC/SCIM or role model, no scheduler or webhook trigger, no pull-request creation and no spend-limit flag; hits were unrelated words or ADR text.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 210 stars, Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-11-17, homepage ordewell.ai; latest release v0.13.3 (2026-11-15) with CLI archives only.

evidence.title: Ordewell home page
evidence.locator: Ordewell home page|hero and how it works
evidence.finding: Apache 2.0, eight supported coding agents, macOS and Linux one binary, Windows via npm, no API key if a coding agent is signed in, nothing runs until approved; no pricing page.

evidence.title: assets/readme/tui-plan-pane.png
evidence.finding: Terminal UI capture with a planner conversation and a seven-task plan with runners, models and states.
